name: Noise: fBm
body:
let v = noise_fbm3(vec3(uv * 5.0, t * 0.3), 5, 2.0, 0.5, 7u);
return vec3(0.5 + 0.5 * v);

name: SDF: guilloche
body:
let v = sdf_polar_guilloche(uv - 0.5, 0.3, 0.08, 7.0, 6, t, 0.003);
return vec3(1.0, 0.76, 0.1) * v;

name: Material: lava
body:
let m = material_lava(uv, 4.0, 0.7, t, 1.0);
return m.albedo + m.emissive;

name: Water: caustics
body:
let v = water_caustic_layered(uv * 4.0, t);
return vec3(0.02, 0.2, 0.3) + vec3(0.7, 0.9, 1.0) * v;

name: Post: fire
body:
let h = post_fire_column(vec2(uv.x - 0.5, 1.0 - uv.y), t, 0.5, 1.5, 1.0);
return post_fire_ramp_classic(clamp(h, 0.0, 1.0));

name: Organic: brain coral
body:
let v = organic_brain_groove(uv * 3.0, 2.0, 2.0 + sin(t * 0.2));
return mix(vec3(0.9, 0.55, 0.45), vec3(0.2, 0.05, 0.08), v);

name: Creature: jellyfish
Terrain: DLA height
body:
let v = terrain_dla_height(uv * 3.0, 4, 0.5 + 0.3 * sin(t * 0.3), 1u);
return vec3(v);

name: Pattern: phase rings
body:
let v = pattern_radial_phase_rings(uv * 2.0 - 1.0, 12.0, 7.0, 1.5, 2.0 * sin(t * 0.3), 0.4);
return vec3(v);
